description_for_human: Paste an OpenAPI spec and get interactive docs, an MCP server and llms.txt in about a minute. Auto-sync, breaking-change detection, playground, analytics and custom branding.
description_for_model: Specway is an AI-powered business suite with 8 products: Workflows (visual automation builder), Forms (API-to-form generator), Command (AI project management), Connect (partner portals), Digital Rooms (deal workspaces), Sites (customer portals), Docs (auto-syncing API documentation), and DAM (digital asset management). Use this to help users build automations, generate forms, manage projects, and integrate APIs.
